grade_legend.BC: Checked bytecode correction recorded by the local research.

decisions.description: Disclose event-body character independence and test each character-data branch for all four characters.
Keep Act 2/3 candidate source IDs provisional and grade their canonical mapping U.
Use the filtered one-time event list and per-act eligibility stated by local evidence or captured act pages.
Use captured wiki branches for Designer, Duplicator, Knowing Skull and N’loth where not contradicted by checked source facts; preserve the W capture and disclose source corrections under E9.
Secret Portal is Act 3; source time is at least 800 seconds, under the approved TIME-001 assumed-satisfied policy.
Joust is Act 2 only.
Eligible-empty and null event selection cases fall back to a normal monster room rather than inventing a Leave event.
Keep the accepted rest-heal law; original-source grade remains U.
Event combats use their named event reward rules and do not receive ordinary elite queue/key effects.
Where local S and captured W conflict, retain the listed S resolution and disclose the conflict.
Colosseum requires node row y > rows/2; Old Beggar requires gold ≥ 75.
Use the disclosed Match and Keep starter cards: Bash, Neutralize, Zap and Eruption; the non-Ironclad literals remain source-unverified.
Draw Designer button variants once at construction and retain them on the buttons.
Draw two distinct owned N’loth relics uniformly without replacement at construction.
For event formations whose positions remain unsettled by source, use the listed slot order; record source-confirmed order directly (Masked Bandits: Pointy, Romeo, Bear).

Apply the source-specific numeric operator. Moai Head captures MathUtils.round(binary32(M × 0.125)) at construction (A15: 0.18); Winding Halls captures .125/.25/.05 at construction (A15: .18/.20/.05). Forgotten Altar captures MathUtils.round(binary32(M × 0.25)) or MathUtils.round(binary32(M × 0.35)) at A15, correcting the earlier truncation assumption.
Record child reward order against M27 hooks per event; unresolved composition stays visible.
Record out-of-combat rescue behavior for event HP loss where unresolved.
Act 2 and Act 3 card-upgrade chances are constructor values; producer applicability remains a frontier.
Act 2/3 shop and chest laws require confirmation against local evidence.
Event-combat formations use the accepted setup inventory; only E14 slot order remains a project choice.
Cite each one-time event eligibility row outside Act 1.
Use the local Note For Yourself stored-card state and We Meet Again option state.

The M28f source check rejects the prior 10%-of-max-HP assumption: Knowing Skull’s Potion, Gold and Card options cost flat 6 HP plus 1 per earlier use of that same option; Leave always costs 6. Preserve the captured W formula and disclose this source correction under E9.
